Q-8808: What day of the week was 2020-11-03?
Answer: Tuesday

Reasoning: 2020-01-01 was a Wednesday. 2020 is a leap year (366 days). 2020-11-03 is the 308th day of the year. 307 days after Jan 1. 307 mod 7 = 6. Wednesday + 6 days = Tuesday. So 2020-11-03 was a Tuesday.
